gateEvidenceNote:
The author's native pre-push log (logs/verify-local-2026-09-18T*.log) was deleted along with its worktree reverent-bartik-501488, so this landing session ran the gates itself at d098ac7e in its own worktree, on local branch review-476.

Why the stages were run directly: scripts/verify-local.ps1 stops at its first failing stage. Under this review-only claim its write-scope drift stage would stop on the reviewed delta before any test ran. So the four required gates ran directly in verify-local's order, each stage logged with start, end, HEAD and exit code.

First run (gate476-2026-09-23T02-26-50Z.log (this landing session's scratchpad; SHA-256 BC098B2A2C49BB7B6F4AEBDA4A06736D80692CC1B39612759E8821D16C78AAC4, 129,620 bytes, 1461 lines)):
- git diff --check: exit 0 (line 3).
- npm test: exit 1 (lines 4-56). One test failed: src/agent-machinery-guard.test.ts, the check that .claude/autopilot.json states the same current clamp as the code. 7,350 passed, 4 skipped.
- npm run build, cargo test and clippy: all passed (lines 57-1460).
- The run ended with porcelain empty and HEAD d098ac7e (line 1461).

Why that npm test failure is baseline, not this PR's: the failing check reads the gitignored, local-only .claude/autopilot.json. This worktree's copy had been rewritten by tooling from newer main to a HISTORICAL note with no clamp sentence, because main removed the stop-continue hook and this guard in 8668cc7c and 75c80f65. The PR touches neither the test nor the file. The guard's own comment says the file exists only in the primary checkout and in no worktree, clone or CI runner, and the check skips when the file is absent.

The rerun (npmtest476-2026-09-23T02-31-36Z.log (this landing session's scratchpad; SHA-256 363CF04C7AAB1A5302220E998358F08231246C96E0FA16CE2C3507E0C5A28499, 2,928 bytes, 37 lines)) put the file aside, as in that designed condition: 448/448 files, 7,347 passed / 5 skipped / 0 failed, with porcelain empty and HEAD d098ac7e (line 36). The count is 3 lower because the guard's SCANNED list filters .claude/autopilot.json with existsSync. With the file absent, those 3 scans of it drop out, and all 3 had passed in the first run.

- The focused test npx vitest run tools/entry/gh-read-bound.test.mjs passed 12/12.
- It was falsified once by removing ', timeout' from the exec options at gather.mjs:51, which failed 11 of 12 tests. The file was restored with git checkout -- tools/entry/gather.mjs, giving 12/12 again with porcelain empty.
